title: ENFERMEIRO SUPERVISOR - APD
description:
O Programa tem como objetivo apoiar pessoas com deficiência intelectual e sua família em sua inserção na sociedade e na busca por autonomia. O serviço se dá por meio de visitas domiciliares e do acompanhamento e da supervisão em atividades cotidianas, como idas ao mercado e passeios em parques, praças e outros locais de convivência. Os profissionais acompanham e orientam os usuários até que eles desenvolvam a capacidade de realizar tais atividades sozinhos.


As equipes do APD ficam nos Centros Especializados em Reabilitação (CERs) e são compostas de Enfermeiro, Psicólogo, Terapeuta Ocupacional e Acompanhantes da Pessoa com Deficiência.


Atualmente, a SPDM/PAIS gerencia equipes do Programa Acompanhante da Pessoa com Deficiência que atuam em três CERs.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Responder técnico administrativamente pelo Programa;
  2. Compor a equipe, participando das intervenções necessárias ao cumprimento dos objetivos do Programa e da rotina de trabalho;
  3. Representar a equipe em reuniões técnicas e eventos;
  4. Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes, metodologia e metas do Programa na área de sua responsabilidade;
  5. Acompanhar o desenvolvimento do Programa na sua área de abrangência;
  6. Promover, junto com a equipe, o estabelecimento de parcerias, visando ampliar a rede de serviços e suporte social às pessoas com deficiência;
  7. Estimular, e propiciar a participação das Pessoas com Deficiência, cuidadores e familiares, no planejamento e avaliação das ações do Programa;
  8. Participar de reuniões técnicas da Unidade de Saúde;
  9. Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;
  10. Organizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe do Programa para definição e avaliação das estratégias de atuação e formação técnica;
  11. Realizar levantamentos de dados, controles administrativos, acompanhar indicadores quantitativos e qualitativos do Programa;
  12. Apresentar a produção mensal da equipe de trabalho para inclusão no Sistema;
  13. Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  14. Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD;
  15. Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Especialização: Pós Graduação Completa em Gestão em Saúde / Saúde Pública.
  • Experiência em supervisão ou como enfermeiro líder em APD.
  • Disponibilidade para vagas de cobertura de afastamento.

40h semanais - horário comercial

  3. Fornecer suporte psicológico e aconselhamento a colaboradores que enfrentam dificuldades emocionais, estresse, ansiedade, depressão e burnout, com foco em promover o bem-estar e a resiliência.
  4. Realizar atendimentos de urgência ou crises para colaborar no manejo de situações críticas que afetam o trabalhador.
  5. Planejar e implementar programas de prevenção e promoção de saúde mental, como palestras, campanhas educativas, grupos de apoio e treinamentos voltados ao desenvolvimento de habilidades emocionais e resiliência.
  6. Propor estratégias para mitigar riscos psicossociais e fatores de estresse, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do clima organizacional.
  7. Colaborar com a equipe de Gestão de Pessoas e lideranças na identificação de condições que possam impactar a saúde psicológica dos colaboradores.
  8. Oferecer orientação para os gestores em questões relacionadas ao desenvolvimento de um ambiente psicologicamente seguro e ao suporte a colaboradores em situações de estresse ocupacional.
  9. Participar de exames ocupacionais e avaliações periódicas, atuando junto à equipe médica para avaliar aspectos emocionais e psicossociais que possam impactar a saúde do colaborador.
  10. Elaborar laudos e relatórios psicológicos quando necessário, fornecendo subsídios para a tomada de decisão em casos de afastamentos ou readaptações funcionais.
  11. Atuar na mediação de conflitos organizacionais que possam interferir na saúde mental e bem-estar dos colaboradores, propondo intervenções que promovam a colaboração e a comunicação saudável.
  12. Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de uma cultura organizacional de acolhimento e apoio, com foco na prevenção de assédio e promoção de respeito no ambiente de trabalho.
  13. Manter a confidencialidade e privacidade dos colaboradores, respeitando as normas éticas e o código de ética profissional do Psicólogo.
  14. Garantir que as práticas psicológicas estejam em conformidade com a legislação e regulamentações de saúde ocupacional.

Competências

Metodologias Assistenciais; Planejamento; Monitoramento; Avaliação; Gestão de Resultados; Tomada de Decisão; Autonomia Técnica

Benefícios

Vale Transporte; Seguro de Vida; Auxílio Creche; Vale Alimentação; Refeitório no local

Sobre a Congregação

A Congregação das Irmãs de Santa Marcelina foi fundada pelo Beato Luigi Biraghi em 1838, na Itália, motivado pelos valores éticos, humanitários e cristãos, por meio do amor e do exemplo educador. As Irmãs realizam sua missão nos continentes: americano, europeu e africano, presentes na Albânia, Benin, Brasil, Canadá, Inglaterra, Itália, México e Suíça. No Brasil, atuam em nove estados: Bahia, Brasília, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, Santa Catarina, São Paulo e Tocantins.

Há mais de 60 anos, a Congregação é responsável pelo Santa Marcelina Saúde composto pela rede de 7 hospitais (Porto Velho-RO, Sapezal-MT, Itaquaquecetuba-SP, Cidade Tiradentes-SP, Itaim Paulista-SP, Itaquera-SP e São Bernardo do Campo-SP) e mais de 140 serviços de Atenção Primária à Saúde localizados na região leste do município de São Paulo. Tornou-se uma importante referência na prestação de serviços e pela atuação nos diferentes níveis de atenção à saúde, por meio do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), Convênios e Particulares.

Essa função é ideal para um(a) profissional de controle de qualidade experiente com paixão por automação, atenção aos detalhes e mentalidade colaborativa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter estruturas abrangentes de automação de testes, impulsionando a eficiência e a consistência no processo de controle de qualidade.
  • Liderar os esforços de teste em vários projetos, garantindo uma cobertura completa de testes funcionais, de regressão, de desempenho e de API.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com desenvolvedores, Product Owners e outras partes interessadas para estabelecer e refinar critérios de aceitação e requisitos de teste.
  • Identificar, analisar e priorizar defeitos de software, garantindo a resolução oportuna em colaboração com as equipes de desenvolvimento.
  • Orientar os membros da equipe de controle de qualidade de nível júnior e médio, promovendo as melhores práticas em testes e automação.
  • Fornecer liderança em cerimônias ágeis, como planejamento de sprint, retrospectivas e stand-ups diários, para garantir que as considerações de qualidade sejam integradas em todos os estágios de desenvolvimento.
  • Analisar os resultados dos testes, gere relatórios e apresente insights acionáveis para as equipes de projeto e as partes interessadas.
  • Impulsionar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, otimizando processos, ferramentas e metodologias de controle de qualidade.
  • Defender uma cultura de qualidade identificando riscos, defendendo melhorias de teste e mantendo-se à frente das tendências do setor em controle de qualidade e automação.

Requisitos:

Habilidades técnicas:

  • Experiência em testes de aplicativos da web (incluindo sites móveis responsivos) - em particular, plataformas de vendas B2B e B2B2C
  • Experiência em funções de automação de QA/QA, com foco na construção e dimensionamento de estruturas de automação de teste.
  • Experiência em ferramentas de automação como Selenium, Cypress, Playwright ou equivalente.
  • Forte proficiência em linguagens de script e programação, incluindo JavaScript, Python ou Java.
  • Capacidade comprovada de integrar automação com pipelines de CI/CD usando Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD ou ferramentas semelhantes.
  • Conhecimento de ambientes de nuvem AWS e experiência em testes em ambientes distribuídos.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de conteinerização como Docker e plataformas de orquestração como Kubernetes.

Habilidades interpessoais:

  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas excepcionais, com a capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de qualidade.
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança e orientação, com foco em promover a colaboração e o crescimento dentro das equipes de controle de qualidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais, com capacidade de apresentar insights técnicos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Uma mentalidade proativa, sempre buscando oportunidades para melhorar a qualidade e os processos de teste.

Qualificações preferenciais:

  • Inglês fluente / proficiente
  • Experiência no domínio de serviços financeiros, com compreensão de seus requisitos exclusivos de conformidade e segurança.
  • Familiaridade com estruturas de escalonamento ágil como SAFe ou LeSS

POR QUE CAPCO:

Juntar-se à Capco significa ingressar em uma organização comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo onde você é incentivado a #BeYourselfAtWork (Ser Você Mesmo no Trabalho). HSEQ Manager (Health, Safety, Environment, Quality – with Social & Environmental Focus)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

We are seeking an experienced HSEQ Manager with a strong background in environmental and social risk management to lead the implementation of the Integrated Management System (IMS) on a large-scale infrastructure project in Angola . This role will be instrumental in ensuring full compliance with international standards and in fostering a proactive culture of safety, environmental protection, quality, and social performance across all project phases.

This position is based in Angola and will contribute to the promotion of a proactive HSEQ culture aligned with international standards and best practices.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Integrated Management System (IMS) in alignment with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.
  • Ensure full compliance with national legislation and international frameworks (IFC Performance Standards, Equator Principles, and World Bank EHS Guidelines).
  • Oversee the application of environmental and social mitigation measures, including biodiversity management, stakeholder engagement, and grievance mechanisms.
  • Guide and mentor the HSEQ team, ensuring alignment with project goals, clear task allocation, and staff development.
  • Lead incident investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Coordinate stakeholder and community engagement in close collaboration with the social performance team.
  • Ensure quality assurance in construction activities through regular inspections, audits, and follow-up on non-conformities.
  • Deliver training and awareness sessions on HSEQ and ESG-related topics across all levels of the project team

Key Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Social Sciences, Occupational Health & Safety, or related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in HSEQ roles with strong emphasis on environmental and social compliance, preferably in infrastructure or EPC projects.
  • Proven track record implementing IFC Performance Standards.
  • Strong knowledge of international IMS standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
  • Demonstrated experience working in multi-stakeholder environments, including engagement with local communities and government entities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and analytical skills.
  • Experience working in African countries is considered an asset.
  • Languages : Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory. Spanish is considered an asset.

Hybrid Work: Our team embraces the hybrid work model, appreciating its blend of flexibility and structure. We combine three days of in-person collaboration at our global offices in Toronto, Dublin, Antwerp, Porto, and Melbourne with the convenience of two days of remote work each week.

Benefits: Nitro provides all employees with a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, dental and vision coverage, and wellness perks. We also offer pension/401k matching, along with many other country-specific benefits.

title: Senior Portfolio Analyst
description:
• Business Units: MG - International Markets

Company Description

With over 6,000 employees in more than 20 countries, Statkraft is one of the leaders in hydropower internationally and the largest generator of renewable energy in Europe. The Norwegian group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power, and provides district heating.

With actions guided by ethics and transparency, the company is headquartered in the city of Florianópolis, Santa Catarina (SC). Currently, it controls 26 renewable generation assets in Brazil. In November 2023, Statkraft signed the purchase of Enerfín, the renewable subsidiary of the Spanish company Elecnor, which includes nine operational wind farms in the states of Rio Grande do Sul and Rio Grande do Norte. Thus, the company became one of the largest wind power generators in Brazil, surpassing the mark of 2.2 GW of installed capacity, including acquisitions, constructions, and operations in the country.

The company is a pioneer in offering traceable renewable energy with a guarantee of origin in Brazil, certifying, through the I-REC (International Renewable Energy Certificate), the origin of its energy production, ensuring that the operation is sustainable.

Job Description

We are looking for someone who can lead the development and the implementation of portfolio tools for the Asset book, and support and propose commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, taking into consideration the expansion of the asset fleet (greenfield and M&A projects) also as R2M opportunities.

As part of this role, you will also:

  • Develop, improve and maintain the modelling of portfolio tools for the Asset book;
  • Propose and assess commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, focusing on long-term value creation and risk mitigation aspects;
  • Support the Energy Management team on suggesting commercial strategies for maturities up to Y+5;
  • Assess the impact of Greenfield and M&A projects on the asset portfolio, including base case and sensitivities scenarios;
  • Support BD and M&A teams on the related processes;
  • Estimate the impact of R2M opportunities (LT PPAs, self-productions, etc) on the asset portfolio, taking into consideration updated market inputs from commercial teams (Trading and Origination);
  • Liaise closely with the risk department on P&L estimations and risk measurement for the Assets portfolio.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economy or Business Administration;
  • Solid experience in the electricity sector in Brazil;
  • Knowledge in Risk Analysis and R / Python coding;

description:
We’re seeking an Account Consultant to join our newly established Dive & Rescue team, spearheading strategic interactions with unmanaged at-risk of attrition sellers through customized 90-day account management plans. This role combines hands-on seller interaction and in-depth performance and status analysis to develop and implement personalized seller support, with room for conducting systematic solutions that address recurring challenges. Overall, aiming to enhance marketplace retention. As a pioneering member of this team, you’ll have the opportunity to participate on shaping the team’s direction. The ideal candidate will bring a dynamic blend of relationship management expertise & analytical thinking. Goal is for you to drive initiatives that deliver measurable impact on seller success while contributing to the foundation of a new unit.
Key job responsibilities
Analysis & Direct Seller Engagement:
- Analyze root causes and conditions leading to sellers' unmanaged, at-risk, or post-attrition status
- Build and maintain seller relationships through multi-channel communication (phone, email, etc.) with consistent check-ins
- Research and understand seller cohort characteristics, including trends, seasonality, and competitive dynamics to provide targeted guidance
- Gather and analyze seller feedback regarding status, needs, and challenges to develop both personalized and scalable solutions
- Discover and make use of available tools and resources to conduct comprehensive seller profile analysis prior to engagement
Performance Management:
- Diagnose critical performance issues and develop collaborative action plans
- Manage and prioritize seller pipeline effectively to achieve targeted outcomes
- Guide sellers to proficiency with Amazon's tools and programs, promoting self-sufficiency and adherence to marketplace standards
Program & Process Improvement:
- Contribute to implementing efficient SOPs for knowledge sharing within the new Dive & Rescue team
- Identify and document attrition patterns, best practices, and improvement opportunities
- Create and implement preventive programs that address common challenges with scalable solutions
- Partner with internal teams to leverage available resources while advocating for seller needs
Analytics & Reporting:
- Track and analyze performance metrics for both individual sellers and programmatic initiatives
- Monitor and report on seller recovery KPIs and intervention effectiveness
A day in the life
- Review dashboards and reports to check Seller performance metrics
- Research seller profiles and prioritize pipeline
- Prepare talking points for upcoming engagements
- Conduct scheduled and proactive seller calls/meetings
- Respond to urgent seller communications via email
- Send follow-up emails with agreed action items
- Document call outcomes and update action plans
- Update tracking tools with latest interactions and status
- Perform deep-dive analysis of specific seller cases
- Analyze patterns from recent seller interactions
- Document newly discovered issues for potential solutions
- Review aggregated seller feedback to identify common pain points
- Map processes and identify optimization opportunities
- Engage with internal stakeholders to foster and initiate programmatic solutions
About the team
The Dive & Rescue team is a new unit dedicated to supporting unmanaged sellers whose performance indicates they may need additional guidance or are at risk of underperforming and leaving the marketplace. We combine data-driven insights with personalized support to help sellers and tackle attrition by:
- Providing targeted interventions through 90-day management plans that could help sellers recover
- Developing systematic solutions that address recurring challenges
Our team culture embraces:
- Creative problem-solving: We're building our playbook and welcome fresh perspectives
- Data-driven decisions: We combine analytical rigor towards practical business insights
- Collaborative spirit: We work closely with sellers, cross-functional teams and among ourselves
- Continuous learning: Every seller interaction and research is an opportunity to gather meaningful insights
- Proactive mindset: We want to become able to address potential issues before they become critical
We are committed to the process of relentlessly focusing on quality execution to strengthen marketplace retention.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
- More than 2+ year of experience in account management, customer success, or related customer-facing roles
- Basic analytical skills and proficiency with Excel
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Good analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach
- Experience working with business metrics and data analysis
- Knowledge of e-commerce of marketplace environments
- Basic understanding of SQL
- Experience of being at cross-functional teams

description:
A missão de um advogado criminalista é ser um defensor atualizado e dedicado aos clientes, sempre agindo dentro dos limites da lei e respeitando os mais altos padrões éticos da advocacia.

1. Atuação Judicial:

  • Propor Ações: Atuar em processos judiciais, como ações de cobrança, indenização por danos, dissolução de sociedade, revisão de contratos, entre outras.
  • Defender em Ações: Defender clientes em processos judiciais, incluir contrarrazões, defender recursos, elaborar petições iniciais e acompanhar processualmente.
  • Executar Sentenças: Auxiliar na execução de sentenças judiciais, como cobrar dívidas ou cumprir decisões de natureza alimentar, familiar ou contratual.
  • Atuar em Ações Cautelares: Em situações urgentes, atuar em medidas cautelares, como requerer tutela antecipada, arresto ou sequestro de bens, para assegurar o resultado de um processo.
  • Acompanhar Litígios: Representar o cliente em audiências de conciliação, instrução e julgamento, além de elaborar estratégias jurídicas para o andamento dos processos.

2. Atuação Extrajudicial:

- Prestar Consultoria Jurídica: Orientar preventivamente sobre direitos e deveres do cliente, visar evitar litígios e prevenir problemas legais.

  • Negociar Acordos: Mediar e negociar entre as partes envolvidas em um conflito, buscar soluções amigáveis para evitar o processo judicial. Aplicar em questões de família, contratos, disputas entre empresas, entre outras.
  • Elaborar e Revisar Contratos: Redigir contratos de compra e venda, prestação de serviços, locação, sociedades, acordos comerciais etc., assegurar que as cláusulas estejam conforme a legislação e protejam os interesses das partes envolvidas.
  • Formalizar Acordos: Elaborar termos de acordo, escrituras públicas, distratos, ajustes entre partes, visar formalizar soluções extrajudiciais e evitar litígios.
  • Atuar em Acordos de Mediação e Arbitragem: Caso as partes optem por soluções alternativas de resolução de disputas, atuar em processos de mediação e arbitragem.

3. Redação de Documentos:

- Elaborar Contratos: Elaborar e revisar contratos de diferentes naturezas, como comerciais, de prestação de serviços, de parceria, entre outros.

  • Redigir Testamentos e Escrituras Públicas: Elaborar testamentos, escrituras públicas de compra e venda, doações, entre outros documentos legais.
  • Elaborar Notificações e Petições: Redigir notificações extrajudiciais, petições e solicitações diversas, como notificações de inadimplência ou de cobrança.
  • Preparar Distratos e Aditivos Contratuais: Elaborar documentos que formalizam a alteração ou rescisão de contratos existentes.

4. Negociações e Resolução de Conflitos:

- Negociar Dívidas e Condições de Pagamento: Intermediar negociações de dívidas, propor acordos que facilitem o pagamento e evitem ações judiciais.

  • Resolver Disputas de Propriedade: Negociar acordos entre as partes envolvidas em disputas de posse ou propriedade, como acordos de condomínio ou regularização de imóveis.
  • Mediar Acordos de Família: Em questões familiares (como divórcios e partilhas), atuar na negociação de acordos amigáveis, sem a necessidade de litígio judicial.
  • Participar em Mediação e Arbitragem: Atuar em processos de mediação e arbitragem, métodos alternativos para resolução de conflitos sem recorrer ao judiciário.

5. Assessoria e Planejamento:

- Planejar Patrimônio: Prestar consultoria na organização e planejamento de patrimônio, como planejar sucessão e gerir bens em vida.

  • Assessorar sobre Direitos de Consumo e Empresas: Orientar sobre as melhores práticas e direitos relacionados ao consumidor e às relações empresariais, prevenir conflitos e ações judiciais.
  • Orientar sobre Responsabilidade Civil: Assessorar sobre situações de risco à responsabilidade civil, como acidentes, danos causados a terceiros e outras implicações legais.

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

No âmbito da parceria com a Enel Distribuição São Paulo e Ceará, a AVSI Brasil atuará a partir de 2025 na execução e formatação sistemática do PROGRAMA ECOENEL - Troca de resíduos por bônus na conta de energia. Esta iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

O/a Coordenador Operacional atuará no monitoramento e análise de dados do projeto, apoiando na elaboração de relatórios periódicos de desempenho das metas e demais atividades administrativas do projeto. title: Mgr,ASU Supply Chain Plng
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for tactical and operational supply chain planning and network optimization of bulk ASU products (LIN, LOX and LAR) in US and Canada.
  • Identify and assess longer term projects/opportunities that deliver cost savings, productivity, and efficiency improvements in the ASU supply chain.
  • Provides key supply chain input to strategic growth initiatives.
  • This position is the primary interface between Supply and the field sales organizations to understand changes in current and future demand and to ensure the supply network is prepared to serve that demand at the lowest overall delivered cost.

Primary Interface between Markets/Sales, Strategic Product Management, and Operations for ASU products:

  • Primary day-to-day interface with account managers and regional Markets leadership on understanding changes in customer demand that will affect supply network configuration.
  • Provide product availability and costing analyses to Strategic Product Management for over DOA-based new business and investment case analyses and senior management for overall business management.
  • Executes ASU energy and diesel surcharge policy defined by Strategic Product Management and Markets based on major cost changes within the network.
  • Support Tonnage account managers on liquid back-up or supplemental concerns (volume availability and costing).

Tactical Supply Chain Planning and Optimization:

  • Assigns plant production rates, operating modes and inventory targets in collaboration with Remote Operating Center engineers and Energy Procurement team to minimize overall product costs. This includes day-of plant turndowns/shutdowns to meet power reduction obligations and minimize/avoid peak power costs.
  • Responsible for coordinating with scheduling teams on inventory vs alternate sourcing needs to minimize impact to customers.
  • Ensures all mid- and long-term purchase agreements are utilized based on lowest total incremental costs.
  • Responsible for development, use and compliance to proprietary network optimization systems (TACT), including quality of inputs and adherence to outputs.
  • Execute supply reviews with Supply field regions and develop operational plans for Sales and Operations Planning. Sets transport resource levels required to fulfill plan while minimizing assets and costs.

Operative Supply Chain Response:

  • Responsible for ensuring sufficient inventory for all pipeline demand (gaseous) and internal plant uses through inventory planning via plant mode changes, liquid product transfers between storage tanks, liquid imports (as required) and/or coordinating deliveries from third parties.
  • Plan, track and own the outage process for ASU. Includes developing plans, forecasting and tracking costs, and providing timely communication on the status of the network during planned and unplanned outages.

Systems Usage & Maintenance:

  • Parcview, J5, Telemetry
  • TACT, Optimizer and potential new, future network optimization tools
  • Sales and Operations Planning including Demand Planning tools
  • SAP and GOLD
  • SAP Analytics Cloud for data visualization

Others:

  • Supervises ASU logistics analyst who is responsible for immediate term coordination of supply network, managing finished product inventories and take-or-pays and FOB (pickup) customers.
  • Responsible for developing key operational assumptions and associated costs for the annual budgeting process and ongoing reforecasts, including purchases, rail shipments, planned outage (dislocation) costs.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in logistics, supply chain, business or engineering.
  • Minimum of 7 years experience in industrial gases or related process industry with supply chain management experience.
  • C.P., M.B.A. and six sigma certifications are a plus.

Required key skills:

  • Strong strategic and tactical thinking are required to analyze and manage a dynamic national network.
  • Must have strong Microsoft Office skills, especially in Excel, Power Point and Word.
  • SAP skills are required.
  • Strong, effective communications are required.
  • Ideal candidate would understand when to push issues and when to let a system work to correct it.
  • Strong prioritization management skills are a must.

Required critical behaviors:

  • Critical
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Information Sharing
  • Change Management
  • Growth Drive
  • Capability Development
  • Supportive
  • Partnership Building

Messer’s safety culture, commitment to providing dependable supply and innovative gas technology solutions help customers unlock opportunities to be safer, more sustainable, more productive and more efficient, so their business thrives. We nurture lasting, meaningful relationships with customers, our communities, and with one another.

description:

Overview

Up to $2000 Bonus

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At Concentra, you will be a vital member of our patient care team and play a crucial role in providing exceptional care to our patients. Our mission is to improve the health of America's workforce, one patient at a time. Join us at Concentra and see how your clinical competency and compassion can make a meaningful difference in the lives of the patients you serve.

The Radiologic Technologist & Medical Support Specialist performs routine x-ray examinations in accordance with Concentra policies, practices, and procedures and applicable regulations under direct supervision of the treating clinician, as well as supports in other needed areas of the facility. This role requires efficient and accurate delivery of one-on-one patient care while thriving in a fast-paced environment. The RT MSS ensures that every patient is treated with quality clinical care and receives an excellent patient experience from welcoming, respectful, and skillful colleagues.

Responsibilities

Radiologic Technologist Duties

  • Prepare patients for radiologic procedures. Escort patients to dressing and x-ray rooms, provide verbal and/or written instructions and assist patients in positioning body parts to be radiographed. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure patient care, safety, and comfort during the x-ray exam.
  • Operate radiologic equipment to produce images of the body for diagnostic purposes. Position radiologic equipment and adjust controls to set exposure time and distance according to specification of examination. Take x-rays following established radiologic requirements and regulations to ensure patient care and safety.
  • Use radiation safety measures and protection devices to ensure safety of patients and team members.
  • Ensure radiologic equipment remains in working order. Report equipment malfunctions to Center Operations Director.
  • Ensure all Radiology workflows are followed and all Radiology reports are correctly entered into EMR.
  • Follow documentation procedures and complete required documentation related to patient x-ray visits.
  • Maintain all x-ray equipment, including calibration, QA/QC procedures, and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures.

Medical Assistant Duties

  • Perform Department of Transportation (DOT) and Non-DOT drug and alcohol testing.
  • Prepare patients for physical examinations, including vital signs and ancillary testing (vaccines, phlebotomy, PFTs, audiograms, respirator fit testing, etc.).
  • Perform rapid screening tests (influenza, strep, mono, glucose, etc.).
  • Assist providers during examinations and treatments.
  • Perform routine medical procedures as ordered, and triage emergent patients as needed.
  • Assist with procedure setup and injury care.
  • Apply bandages, dressings, and splints as ordered.
  • Dispense medications and DME as ordered, in accordance with regulations.
  • Complete quality assurance activities on equipment and devices.
  • Maintain supplies, clean rooms, and operate all medical devices, including calibration and record keeping.
  • Notify supervisor of equipment issues or supply needs.
  • Assist with patient flow and volume management.
  • Keep patients informed of wait times.
  • Handle clerical tasks, including documentation, check-in/out, and communication.
  • Follow HIPAA and safety guidelines.
  • Attend staff meetings and maintain a clean, organized facility.
  • Complete ongoing training as required.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Graduate of an accredited radiologic technology program with applicable state certification.
  • Registered with ARRT with active certification.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification.

Experience and Skills

  • At least six months of medical assistant experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of occupational medicine requirements is a plus.
  • Service-oriented, detail-focused, with a sense of urgency, initiative, and flexibility.
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive information per HIPAA and PHI regulations.
  • Team player with good working relationships at all levels.
  • Ability to obtain necessary certifications, including drug screen and collection certifications.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office.

Additional Benefits

  • 401(k) with employer match.
  • Medical, vision, dental, telehealth coverage.
  • Life and disability insurance.
  • Paid time off and illness days.
  • Referral bonus, tuition reimbursement, commuter benefits, dependent care accounts, and employee discounts.

This role requires handling confidential information with discretion. Concentra is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities during the application and employment process.

title: Planning and Scheduling Team Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Planning and Scheduling Team Manager role at Air Products

5 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Planning and Scheduling Team Manager role at Air Products

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
Reimagine What’s Possible
Rotoflow is a full-service turbomachinery OEM - providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and aftermarket services to our customers globally. For over 75 years, Rotoflow has designed and manufactured both standard and custom-engineered cryogenic and warm gas centrifugal turbomachinery used in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Products include compressor loaded turbo-expanders, generator-loaded power recovery expanders, and low-cost dissipative expanders. We offer new equipment designs, rerates, upgrades and repair along with field services, engineering evaluations, reliability, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, shop services, and new equipment replacements for all types of centrifugal and reciprocating equipment. Our customers are served globally through regional service centers supported by both regional and centralized execution teams.
Gardner Cryogenics designs and manufactures high-performance, highly reliable, long-lasting storage tanks used to transport hydrogen and helium molecules around the globe. With more than six decades of experience, Gardner provides customers with industry-leading technology that enables them to cost-effectively move and store molecules with near zero loss. The unique technology developed by Gardner provides the lowest heat-leak for the highest yield when transporting, storing, and transferring helium and hydrogen.
We are seeking a results-oriented Planning and Scheduling Team Manager for our Gardner Cryogenics and Rotoflow manufacturing facilities, within the Lehigh Valley, PA. This position will be responsible for managing planning and scheduling team and overseeing the entire process from new order intake through delivery of contract, including aggregating information for resource planning, reporting of on-time delivery metrics, and helping to drive process improvements in the speed of execution, process efficiency and fulfilment of orders. This position interfaces closely with Sales and Proposals, Manufacturing, Project Management, Engineering, Procurement and Supply Chain to ensure execution and manufacturing dates are being met. This position will be located in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania and will split time between the Rotoflow and Gardner facilities.
What's In It For You
At Air Products we foster a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard, and everyone feels they belong and matter. Additionally, we offer competitive pay and great benefits for our employees. Check out some of our benefits below!

  • Affordable Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (day 1 of employment)
  • 401k with 100% vested company core and match
  • Paid Vacation, holidays + sick time
  • Paid Parental leave (Up to 8 weeks)
  • Backup Child and Adult Care benefit
  • Adoption assistance
  • Flexible spending accounts (medical, dependent daycare)
  • Life Insurance (AD&D- Paid for by Air Products), Supplemental AD&D
  • Legal Plan & Identity theft coverage
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Many more supplemental benefits available
Key Job Responsibilities
  • Leading and developing the team of planners and schedulers across Gardner and Rotoflow,
  • Acting as a mentor, guide, and decision maker for the team to enable peak performance and remove barriers to progress,
  • Conducting performance evaluations and direct day-to-day management of team members,
  • Setting overarching goals, objectives, and development plans for the team and team members aligned with leadership cascaded goals,
  • Driving the team to efficiently and effectively plan and schedule activities aligned with Project Management milestones and delivery schedules,
  • Owning and driving enhancement and improving accuracy of the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process and reporting out to the Leadership Team,
  • Translating sales opportunity pipeline into workforce and facility demand and capacity planning and scheduling (S&OP),
  • Working closely with Sales and Proposals to anticipate order timing and align proposal schedules and deliveries with current workload, supplier loading and availability, and facility capacity to ensure appropriate customer deliveries are achievable,
  • Setting priorities, finding solutions, and collaborating with all disciplines within the business to enable the faithful execution of work,
  • Driving the optimization of plans and schedules based on inputs (part availability, resource availability, work center availability, etc.) to accommodate unplanned or unforeseen circumstances such as customer emergencies,
  • Developing a world class planning and scheduling work processes, systems, and tools to enable efficient and effective execution of all aspects of work aligned with the business growth goals,
  • Assessing and resolving limitations, gaps, constraints, bottlenecks, delays, and other unplanned barriers impacting engineering and manufacturing,
  • Leading production meetings,
  • Developing and owning key performance indicators for planning and scheduling and reporting out to the Leadership Team,
Minimum Hiring Requirements
  • B.S. in a technical discipline preferred. Experience considered in lieu of a technical degree.
  • Minimum 5 years of planning and scheduling experience with discrete equipment manufacturing or similar.
  • Prior leadership experience leading a team of direct reports.
  • Exemplify a passion for winning and ability to motivate teams.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Production Planning module preferred.
  • Certifications such as PPM, APICS, ASM, or related are a strong plus.
  • Experience with MS Office Suite, (Excel, Word, Project, Outlook, PowerPoint) required.
  • Broad strategic thinker, with a clear vision and direction to improve business performance.
  • Proven track record for planning and scheduling process improvement and results.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills. Identify and recommend alternative solutions and translate complex concepts into simplified and understandable examples.
  • Detail, goal, and results oriented, organized, creative, self-motivated, collaborative, and customer focused.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills (written, verbal and presentation).
  • Highly effective communication, collaboration, conflict management, performance management, data driven and analytical approach.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to work independently on multiple concurrent projects or tasks and collaboratively with engineers, technicians, and suppliers in shop, office, and field environments.
  • High energy, desire to learn new skills, and desire to understand the specifics of the processes and inter-related steps that are required to fulfil a variety of orders, from design, engineering, procurement, and manufacturing.
  • Ability to create an environment of trust and consistently exhibit a positive attitude.

QUEM SOMOS?

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética.

GS 17

Requirements and skills

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado;

description:
Responsabilidades do Cargo:

  • Conduzir estudos de HAZOP de forma independente, liderando sessões com times multidisciplinares e garantindo aderência às metodologias aplicáveis;
  • Elaborar e revisar documentos técnicos de segurança de processos, incluindo análises de riscos, listas de ações, planos de mitigação, entre outros;
  • Participar de projetos de engenharia de segurança industrial, atuando com: Definição e análise de redes de incêndio (hidrantes, sprinklers, detectores, etc.);
  • Estudo e definição de rotas de fuga e saídas de emergência;
  • Projetos de sistemas de detecção e combate a incêndio;
  • Avaliação de layouts quanto à conformidade com normas de segurança;
  • Apoiar projetos multidisciplinares da SANDECH, contribuindo tecnicamente com outras áreas conforme a demanda dos projetos;
  • Realizar outras análises de risco como What-if, LOPA, FMEA, HAZID, sempre que necessário;
  • Interagir com clientes e stakeholders, apresentando resultados técnicos com clareza e propondo soluções aderentes à realidade operacional;
  • Assegurar conformidade com normas e legislações, como NR-10, NR-13, NR-20, NR-23, NFPA, API, IEC 61511, entre outras;
  • Acompanhar a implementação de recomendações de segurança, garantindo rastreabilidade e comunicação eficiente entre as partes envolvidas;
  • Contribuir com a melhoria contínua de processos internos, apoiando a evolução técnica das metodologias e padrões da SANDECH.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia (Química, Processos, Mecânica, Civil, Produção ou áreas correlatas);
  • Pós-graduação em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Experiência comprovada na condução de estudos de HAZOP como líder/facilitador, com autonomia técnica;
  • Conhecimento prático em outras metodologias de análise de riscos, como What-if, FMEA, LOPA e HAZID;
  • Experiência com projetos de engenharia de segurança industrial, incluindo: Redes de incêndio (hidrantes, sprinklers e detectores), rotas de fuga, saídas de emergência, sistemas de combate e detecção de incêndios;
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis, como NR-10, NR-13, NR-20, NR-23, NFPA, API e IEC 61511;
  • Boa comunicação técnica e postura para interação com clientes e times multidisciplinares;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em São Paulo ou Rio de Janeiro;
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em outras frentes técnicas da SANDECH, conforme demanda.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Segurança de Processos, Gerenciamento de Riscos Industriais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificações técnicas específicas em HAZOP, LOPA, FMEA ou normas como NFPA, API, IEC 61511;
  • Experiência anterior em consultorias de engenharia ou empresas do setor industrial com foco em segurança de processos;
  • Familiaridade com softwares de análise de riscos, como PHA Pro, PHAWorks, BowTie XP, entre outros;
  • Conhecimentos de projetos multidisciplinares (ex: processos, instrumentação, automação, layout de plantas industriais);
  • Vivência com clientes de setores regulados, como óleo e gás, químico, petroquímico, papel e celulose, etc.;
  • Inglês técnico (leitura de normas e documentação);
  • Participação em auditorias ou inspeções regulatórias envolvendo segurança de processos ou industrial.

Certificações Obrigatórias:

  • Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho – essencial para atuar com projetos de segurança industrial (exigência legal e técnica);

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. Sobre a vaga

Como Technical Account Manager (TAM), você será a ponte entre nossos clientes e a equipe técnica, garantindo a integração dos dados tanto de entrada quanto de saída. Além disso, será responsável por solucionar desafios técnicos, apoiar na resolução de falhas na integração e garantir uma experiência fluida para o cliente. Se você gosta de tecnologia, tem habilidades analíticas e uma excelente comunicação, essa vaga é para você!

O que você fará no dia-a-dia

  1. Trabalhar diretamente com os clientes garantindo a integração dos dados de entrada e saída e auxiliando os clientes na configuração de acessos, suporte em SQL e validação dos dados antes da integração.
  2. Atuar com diversos ERPs do segmento de varejo a fim de construir, homologar e manter as integrações.

  6. Agilidade e poder de persuasão: Capacidade de negociar com os clientes e stakeholders, em defesa das necessidades e desejos dos clientes sem esquecer das necessidades da empresa.

Será legal se você tiver:

  1. Conhecimento no segmento de Varejo.
  2. Ter trabalhado com ERPs.
  3. Experiência com integrações de dados: Conhecimento sobre bancos de dados relacionais e processos ETL.
  4. Conhecimento em ferramentas no code como Zapier, n8n.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent or advanced proficiency in English.

HABILIDADES

It is through these qualities that we have fostered trusting relationships with each of our clients. We proudly highlight our high returns to our investors coupled with our unwavering commitment to ethical values.

Position Summary:

The digital workplace head is responsible for the strategy and management of digital workplace technologies and services, ensuring a seamless digital employee experience (DEX). This role covers all functions of the digital workplace, including the service desk management, budgeting, and IT asset management (hardware and software), enhancing digital dexterity, and driving positive business outcomes, while maintaining compliance with SOX and ITGC controls.

Main responsibilities:

  • Reporting to Infrastructure Head and partner with the CIO/CTO, human resources, facilities and other IT and business leaders to set the strategic direction of the digital workplace and DEX improvements.
  • Lead the digital workplace operations team focused on fulfilling (telephony included) end-user support and service requests, including the IT service desk, the VIP and desktop support, A/V support, Active Directory, IT services catalogue and IT asset management (hardware & software) inventory.
  • Manage the annual budget for operating and capital expenditures and govern digital workplace technology usage, standards, and licensing to align with IT and company objectives while optimizing costs and enforcing data policies.
  • Contract administration including management of service level for services in the scope including licensing expiration, renewal with different services providers and procurement team.
  • Lead the development, publication and maintenance of the corporate IT catalogue of product and services and its roadmap aligned with business requirements and IT leaders.
  • Provide IT leaders and business with a consolidated overview of IT Service Support KPIs (support tickets and service requests) submitted by the business area, ensuring adherence to SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
  • Champion the modernization of workforce technology and services to enable new ways of working and digital transformation, while demonstrating digital dexterity and fostering a culture of workforce digital dexterity by leading adoption, enablement, and influence to achieve digital business goals.
  • Partner with HR to understand employees’ current challenges, new roles, demographic changes, mobility, hybrid work and more, incorporating this knowledge into digital workplace planning, while utilizing organizational change management best practices to drive technology adoption.
  • Partner with corporate real estate/facilities to create a smart workplace that supports hybrid and remote workers as much as onsite workers.
  • Collaborate with colleagues in internal communications to communicate how digital workplace applications benefit employees through enablement campaigns and measurement of customer satisfaction and eNPS.
  • Work with IT security and risk management to ensure that digital workplace technologies comply with corporate policies and industry standards.
  • Responsible for SOX and ITGC controls within the digital workplace, including the polices creation or update ensuring flawless execution and developing action plans for improvements when necessary.


Main requirements:

  • (5+) years managing IT systems, processes and vendors.
  • (5+) years of leading digital workplace team and processes including external service desk services
  • English mandatory
  • Experience with vendor governance, KPI Management, including demonstrated success in conducting RFPs and vendor service transitions.
  • Proven financial management skills with operational budget tasks.
  • Awareness of ways to measure Digital Experience and satisfaction.
  • Working knowledge of IT frameworks such as ITIL, including key processes – knowledge, incident, change, service request and major-incident management.
  • Proven ability to manage rapidly changing business priorities, processes and technologies.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of digital workplace applications.

It isn’t just the performance that matters. We also care about the way we achieve our targets. We see our way of working as a differentiator, which contributes to retain the best team, to establish long-term relationships with clients, to expand to other countries, and to attract investors and partners who allow us to generate superior returns:

title: Associate Director, Sales
description:
Join to apply for the Associate Director, Sales role at Shure Incorporated .

We are seeking a dynamic, experienced Associate Director, Sales to lead Shure’s sales strategy across South America, overseeing the Brazil-based Channel Marketing and Customer Experience teams serving Latin America. The role involves driving revenue growth through channel partnerships, developing go-to-market strategies, strengthening partner engagement, and aligning with Shure’s brand and business objectives. It also includes shaping long-term goals, uncovering new opportunities, and enhancing the end-user experience.

If you have a strong background in sales and marketing leadership, a deep understanding of the Latin American channel ecosystem, and a proven ability to build collaborative relationships that drive customer success, apply now!

Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese is required. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities

  1. Lead the South America sales organization, managing sales performance, growth targets, and margin improvements. Develop and implement strategic plans to exceed sales targets across all product lines.
  2. Provide leadership to the Sales, Channel Marketing, and Customer Experience teams, ensuring alignment, accountability, and high performance. Set goals, coach team members, and foster a culture of innovation and professional growth.
  3. Manage strategic channel accounts, focusing on growth, value creation, and customer journey improvements. Build long-term relationships with top partners and ensure strategic alignment.
  4. Oversee regional channel marketing and customer engagement initiatives in collaboration with the Brazil-based team supporting Latin America. Ensure programs are effective and aligned with sales objectives, contributing to partner enablement and customer success.
  5. Develop and execute regional channel sales plans with cross-functional teams, identifying gaps and opportunities to increase market penetration and partner performance.
  6. Support regional promotions, product launches, events, and training programs in collaboration with internal teams like product marketing, global accounts, and operations.
  7. Represent the voice of Latin American channel partners internally, providing strategic input on global and regional initiatives. Lead regional projects supporting business transformation.
  8. Manage budgeting and forecasting for regional teams, ensuring alignment with business goals and responsible financial management.
  9. Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
  • 10–12 years of experience in sales and/or channel leadership.
  • 7+ years managing teams and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Knowledge of the professional audio or AV industry is preferred.
  • Experience working with Latin American channel ecosystems.
  • Ability to manage complexity, execute strategies, and lead in a matrix organization.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or similar CRM tools.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills.
  • Ability to inspire and motivate diverse teams.
  • Willingness to travel up to 75%.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Who We Are

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide. Founded in 1925, we are a leading manufacturer of audio equipment, known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless systems, and more. We foster an inclusive culture, offering flexible work arrangements and opportunities for all.

Headquartered in the United States, we have over 35 regional offices, engineering hubs, and manufacturing facilities across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

The Mix Matters

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about this role and share our values, we encourage you to apply. We are committed to an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible workplace.

title: Waste Management Specialist (Summer 2025-2026) - Palmer Station
description:
POSITION: Waste Management Specialist

SEASON: Austral Summer (October - April)

LOCATION: Palmer Station, Antarctica

SECTOR/DEPT: Six Mile, LLC Antarctica

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Act as point of contact for Waste Management and attend weekly staff meetings and teleconferences.
  2. Collect and package for shipment all solid and hazardous wastes on station.
  3. Follow all SOPs associated with position duties.
  4. Ensure proper documentation and filing of all paperwork on time.
  5. Review/update JHA and SDS binders and computer folders.
  6. Use proper PPE for various tasks (correct gloves, respirator, safety glasses, etc.).
  7. Quality check all shipping containers and correct discrepancies immediately.
  8. Process hazardous and radioactive waste per SOPs, including marking, labeling, weighing, and storing.
  9. Perform classification qualitative testing on items (pH testing, flash point testing, etc.).
  10. Consolidate and lab pack wastes as required per profile and classification.
  11. Safely operate various pieces of equipment on station (SkyTraks, ATVs, etc.).
  12. Store processed hazardous wastes according to segregation requirements.
  13. Keep waste inventory records updated and accurate.
  14. Perform quality-assurance checks on inventory database and files.
  15. Provide hazardous waste, solid waste, and spill briefings.
  16. Act as Spill Team Lead for the entire station, write spill reports, and conduct trainings and drills.
  17. Organize, orient, and train members of Spill Team for outside spill response.
  18. Maintain inventory of spill supplies in spill-vans and satellite spill kits.
  19. Assist station mechanic with weekly station fueling activities.
  20. Maintain/deploy spill-boom supplies for station fueling.
  21. Assist with general station needs, including snow removal and radio communications.
  22. Conduct community Waste Briefs or other informational sessions as necessary.
  23. Collect and process Resale Items as needed.
  24. Maintain Maximo Resale work orders and provide end of season report to McMurdo Resale Admin and ASC Property Manager.
  25. Maintain a flexible schedule based on Vessel Operations and other station-wide activities.
  26. Ensure seasonal replacement receives proper training and maintain a log of this information.
  27. Troubleshoot any issues that arise and elevate them as needed.
  28. Supply manual labor (shoveling) for several hours if needed.
  29. Perform regular use of drum dollies, cargo straps, banding, shovels, pallet jacks, power tools, and other tools.
  30. Engage in regular physical activity, including bending, lifting, carrying, reaching, and gripping.
  31. Display self-motivation in a physically challenging and atypical work environment; position is approximately 70% outdoor tasking.
  32. Maintain flexibility and a positive attitude in a dynamic, fast-paced work setting.
  33. Perform duties in support of Operations Division metrics.
  34. Support the achievement of ASC metrics.
  35. Comply with all ASC Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements.
  36. Work to achieve ASC goals and contractual commitments.
  37. Maintain a safe workplace and ensure that safety is the highest priority.
  38. Perform other duties as required.
  39. Reports to Hazardous Waste Manager and Solid Waste Manager.

REQUIREMENTS:

  1. 2 years of USAP Waste Management experience.
  2. College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).
  3. Strong computer software experience.
  4. Able to lift 50 pounds consistently and wear a respirator.
  5. Valid Driver's License and Passport valid for six months after contract end.
  6. Physically able to be active for 9 hours daily.
  7. Must pass physical qualification assessment.
  8. Able to deploy to Antarctica for length of contract.

PREFERRED:

  1. 1 year of Hazardous Materials shipping/characterization or reporting experience or 2 years of Environmental remediation.
  2. 1 year of supervisory experience.
  3. 1 year of High School Chemistry or equivalent.
  4. 1 quarter of college General Chemistry.
  5. College degree in Chemistry or Environmental Science.
  6. OSHA HazWOPER 40-Hour certification, current.
  7. Familiarity with power tools and machinery.
  8. Equipment operating experience.
  9. Previous management or supervisory experience.

EDUCATION:

College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).

CERTIFICATIONS AND/OR LICENSING REQUIREMENTS:

Valid Driver's License and passport valid for six months after end of contract.

OTHER:

US citizenship or permanent residency required.

Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. On a typical day, you will…

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the team responsible for the development and maintenance of our microservices-based core integration engine.

  • Propose technical hypotheses and drive R&D efforts to improve system capabilities.
  • Ensure proper architecture for a highly distributed system.
  • Work closely with the technical team, participating in code reviews, discussions, and validating the use of best practices.

High-Performance Focus

Operational Excellence

People Leadership

What You'll Need To Bring...

title: Gerente de Vendas | Bombas e Rodovias
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração.

Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister, formando o maior líder mundial na área de equipamentos para concreto.

Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany começou em 2007, inicialmente como importador de equipamentos. Em 2011, consolidou sua presença no país com investimentos de aproximadamente US$ 200 milhões. Nesse mesmo ano, inaugurou sua primeira unidade fabril em São José dos Campos, SP, com 30 mil m², para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão, no regime CKD (Completely Knock-Down). Em 2012, recebeu a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008 pela Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini, garantindo rigorosos processos de qualidade e segurança.

Em 2013, iniciou a montagem de guindastes RT (rough terrain) e rolos compactadores em sua unidade de fabricação. No final de 2017, inaugurou instalações em Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias para oferecer produtos e serviços de pós-venda em todo o Brasil.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano estratégico de vendas para o portfólio de Bombas e Rodovias;
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos, garantindo a satisfação do cliente;

Bricsys, part of Hexagon, is a global technology company creating innovative Computer Aided Design software for worldwide markets. Our products enable the world’s most innovative companies to streamline complex design workflows every day. Our people are active in 80 countries, and our software is available in fifteen languages. As a committed long-term business partner, we are investing in the future by expanding our team across the LATAM region. The success of our customers and partners is key to us, and having local experts available plays an important role.

We are currently looking for an experienced Solutions Specialist to join our LATAM Presales team.

As a Solutions Specialist at Bricsys, you will play a pivotal role in driving sales success in the LATAM region by providing advanced technical expertise and support during the sales process.

You will collaborate closely with our regional (pre)sales team and work with our channel partners in the region to understand client needs, demonstrate product capabilities, and develop tailored solutions that align with customer requirements.

The role is offered on a regular, full-time employment contract basis and can be performed remotely in Brazil.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Align with key customer stakeholders to secure business and technical closure of the proposed Bricsys solution.
  • Provide consultancy and best practices for project implementation.
  • Develop and maintain trusted working relationships with Bricsys Reseller Network & Territory Sales.
  • Communicate and materialize clients’ needs with customized solutions.
  • Polish relationships with clients, partners, vendors, and external parties.
  • Conduct sales & channel enablement, including industry and/or product sales demonstrations.
  • Establish and maintain industry leadership through competitive studies and in-depth knowledge of technologies impacting customers & global technology marketplace.
  • Establish workflow and framework for new technology implementation.
  • Manage training and workshops for BIM/VDC related software.

We are looking for:

Skills:

  • Clear passion and commitment to be an innovator.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a consultative approach to sales.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a remote team environment.
  • Understanding of how to define BIM scope, integrate workflow processes, set up standards, manage key stakeholders, and monitor performance.
  • Ability to lead the production and quality assurance processes.
  • Ability to plan and optimize CAD technology implementation.
  • Ability to support pre-sales activities and research, propose and evaluate the latest CAD and BIM technology.

Knowledge:

  • Extensive knowledge of CAD/BIM technology.
  • Extensive knowledge of AEC, BIM and/or Manufacturing sectors in the region and their challenges.
  • Strong knowledge of channel partner/reseller model and developing channel partner relationships.

Experience:

  • 10+ years' professional experience in roles combining technical capabilities and commercial skills, such as Principal Consultant, Implementation Manager, Solution Architect, Practice Manager, Technical Presales Consultant, Application Engineer, or similar.
  • Previous hands-on user experience with CAD/BIM solutions demonstrating a strong understanding of their applications and functionalities.
  • Demonstrable experience researching, evaluating, analyzing, and delivering CAD technology.
  • Demonstrable experience in content development and delivery of CAD software demos, consultancy, workshops, and training.
  • Demonstrable experience establishing BIM workflows and frameworks for new technology implementations.

Education & Other Qualifications:

  • Preferred qualifications in either Architecture, Building Management, or Engineering.
  • Proficiency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Availability to travel in the region as needed for client and partner engagements, as well as industry events.

If you are a passionate and driven professional, we invite you to join our team at Bricsys. This represents an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to join a fast-paced, exciting company on a mission to delight our customers and deliver significant growth.

Interested? We look forward to hearing from you!

title: SAP - Profitability Analisys
description:
A leading global provider of products and services to the energy industry, embarked on a multi-year transformation journey to streamline,

standardize, and digitalize operations by fully implementing a Global ERP System (S/4HANA).

The Key business goals include strengthening data governance, enhancing platform standardization through a “Clean Core” approach, process optimization

and tax and statutory compliance for each location, with an ongoing focus on rapid response to commercial and operational needs.

To meet these goals, workshop sessions must be addressed for each key workstream to make key design decisions in the following areas:

• Financial Statements design and mapping

• Statutory and tax configuration needs

• Data migration/conversion

• Fixed asset tax booking

• E-Document/e-Invoice + DRC (fit to standard analysis and decision on WRICEF needed)

• TRM (Treasury & Risk Management

This transformation journey began with the a value architecting phase, and currently, the implementation phase is undergoing:

The implementation is split into separate releases for deploying SAP S/4HANA in different locations, covering critical processes such as Order-to-Cash (OTC),

Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Hire-to-Retire (H2R), and Enterprise Asset Management (EAM).

The RTR Team Member for SAP Profitability Analysis and Controlling supports the global finance function by managing and optimizing processes related to product costing,cost center accounting, and profitability analysis (CO-PA) in SAP S/4HANA. The role ensures accurate reporting and control of financial data, enabling strategic decision-making and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the Record-to-Report (RTR) process with a focus on Controlling (CO) and Profitability Analysis (CO-PA) .

  • Configure and maintain cost element accounting , cost center accounting , internal orders , and profit centers in SAP.

  • Set up and support account-based and costing-based CO-PA structures, value fields, and characteristics.

  • UAT support for performing variance analysis, actual vs. planned cost comparisons, and profitability reporting.

  • Monitor and support month-end close activities for CO modules including assessments, distributions, settlements , and allocations .

  • Analyze and resolve system or process issues in collaboration with clients' IT and business stakeholders.

  • Provide input into design of enhancements and process improvements.

  • Document configurations, business processes, and training materials.

  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, policies, and external regulatory requirements.

  • Participate in finance transformation or ERP rollout projects as a subject matter expert for SAP CO and CO-PA.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Controlling (CO) and CO-PA modules (S/4HANA experience preferred).

  • Deep understanding of product costing , cost center planning , profitability reporting , and cost allocations .

  • Experience with financial reporting , variance analysis , and month-end close activities .

  • Strong knowledge of integration points between SAP CO, FI, MM, and SD modules.

  • Ability to interpret financial results and explain profitability drivers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a shared services or global business services environment.

  • Experience in profitability analysis for energy, manufacturing or utilities industry .

  • Familiarity with SAP BPC, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) , or Group Reporting is a plus.

  • Professional certifications such as CMA, CPA , or SAP CO certification .

title: IT Business Consultant PIMS
description:
Multinational Swiss Company is seeking a talented IT Business Consultant – Operations Solutions (PIMS) to support its global manufacturing digitalization initiatives. This role will play a key role in the maintenance, optimization, and global expansion of the Production Information Management System (PIMS) landscape — especially with the SAP Digital Manufacturing initiative, for which Brazil will be the first global pilot.

You will work in a collaborative and multicultural environment, in close contact with a global team and a German-based manager, providing end-to-end support for OSIsoft PI systems and related architecture components.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Administer, install, and configure OSIsoft PI System components and interfaces
  • Troubleshoot, maintain, and optimize real-time data historian performance
  • Create and manage PI tags, PI AF, PI Vision dashboards, and PI Batch configurations
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and consistency across historian layers
  • Implement and manage system cybersecurity (OT security, segmentation, DMZs)
  • Develop reports and dashboards for production insights and operational decision-making
  • Collaborate on integration projects between PI System, ERP (SAP), LIMS, and other systems
  • Design, manage, and support cloud and on-premise data infrastructures

  • Contribute to user training, documentation, and stakeholder communication

Technical Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or related area
  • Solid experience with OSIsoft PI System: interfaces, tag configuration, PI Vision, Asset Framework, PI Batch
  • Experience with real-time system administration and PI security management
  • Proficiency in database management and SQL Server administration
  • Experience with OPC servers/clients, API integration, and web services
  • Knowledge in network architecture: TCP/IP, routing, ports, switches, cabling
  • Experience with firewall setup and configuration (e.g., Barracuda)
  • Familiarity with Windows Server, VMware/Hyper-V, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS)
  • Understanding of system backup and disaster recovery procedures
  • Project management experience, preferably in international environments

Soft Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, change-driven environments
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborative team spirit, working across departments and cultures
  • Strong time management and multitasking abilities
  • Attention to detail and proactive issue identification.
  • FLUENT ENGLISH

Technologies:

Part of global SAP Digital Manufacturing rollout, high system ownership, global exposure, pilot project leadership, hybrid model with flexibility, cross-system integration (ERP + PIMS + Cloud).

Descrição de Vagas Diversas

  • Atendimento e Orientação Jurídica: Atendimento e orientação aos clientes sobre benefícios do INSS e regime próprio. Análise de documentos e cálculos previdenciários (tempo de contribuição, carência, etc.).

  • Manutenção de Ar Condicionado: Realizar manutenção e instalação de ar condicionado. Necessária experiência na área.

  • Controle de Estoque: Contagem, arrumação, armazenamento, separação de pedidos e controle de inventário. Necessária experiência com sistemas de gestão.
  • Cuidados com Ambiente: Manutenção da limpeza de salas de clínica e atividades relacionadas. Desejável residir em Osasco.
  • Atividades Administrativas: Gestão de atividades administrativas, atendimento presencial, telefônico e digital, além de bem-estar dos clientes.
  • Preparo de Alimentos: Preparação de alimentos, com agilidade, organização, pró-atividade e bom relacionamento com equipe.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Coordenação e supervisão do inventário, contagem física, garantia de dados precisos e treinamento da equipe.
  • Administração e Estratégia: Apoio na consolidação de processos administrativos, controle orçamentário e suporte à direção. Formação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas similares.
  • Recursos Humanos: Coordenação de equipe, elaboração de políticas internas, análise de desempenho e participação em processos de RH.
  • Vendas de Móveis Planejados: Atendimento ao cliente, identificação de necessidades, prospecção, fechamento de vendas e elaboração de propostas.

description:
