Join to apply for the Engineering Manager- Ceph & Distributed Storage role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware - safely, cheaply and simply.
Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use - from large enterprise data center installations to half-rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard - and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.
What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possibleYou love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

L&D empowers employees to reach their full potential while helping the organization stay agile, competitive, and future-ready.

  • The Learning & Development Manager is responsible for designing and implementing strategies to enhance employee growth, leadership development, and organizational capability.

  • Lead the creation of comprehensive training frameworks, including leadership development, functional upskilling, and soft skills enhancement.
  • Additionally, they will collaborate with business leaders and HR partners to build a strong learning culture, leveraging data-driven insights to measure training effectiveness and continuously refine development initiatives.
  • This role requires a proactive approach to talent planning, coaching, and fostering an environment where employees are empowered to reach their full potential.

  • The Talent Development Expert requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, instructional design, and leadership development expertise.

  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Women, and 99Families.

    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.

We are a remote-first company that is full of inspiring and friendly people.

We are currently searching for a Senior Data Quality Engineer to join our fast-growing team. This position is for someone located in São Paulo, Brazil who is able to come into the office in-person at least once weekly. In this position, you will have the opportunity to work with some of our biggest projects within the retail industry.

About You:

You are a humble, passionate, and experienced engineer that is looking for a collaborative and analytical Data Quality Engineering role to support the execution of our product deliveries and client reporting services. This comprises validating the data flow as a whole, from data sources to data consumers, including BI dashboards and ML models.

As our Senior Data Quality Engineer, you are an extremely detail-oriented, out-of-the-box problem solver with a commitment to doing high-quality work. You will work with the Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams to support the flow of cleaned, quality data to ultimately drive customer success.

How You Will Make an Impact:

  • Lead the data quality engineering team and efforts across the organization
  • Identify metrics used to measure data quality
  • Establish data validations that cover both functional and domain-specific KPI data
  • Monitor data quality metrics and perform root cause analysis of data quality issues, taking appropriate steps to address any issues
  • Make sure that data quality processes are integrated into the data architecture
  • Support all the data governance initiatives
  • Understand the data and KPI reporting requirements for clients, ensuring that the data quality initiatives align

Skills and Qualifications: (even if you do not meet these skills 100%, we still welcome you to apply)

  • BSc or MSc in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or related field
  • 6+ years’ experience in data engineering and quality assessment roles
  • High level of proficiency with Python and SQL
  • Some experience with DBT would be a bonus
  • A strong understanding of data management concepts including data profiling and mapping
  • Skilled in performing data quality assessments to identify data inconsistencies, inaccuracies, and incompleteness in data products
  • Strong analytical skills to identify patterns and trends in data and data quality issues
  • Good understanding of data governance concepts including data privacy and security
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, identifying areas for improvement within the data quality process and workflows
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve data quality issues, including identifying the root cause of problems and implementing effective solutions
  • Above-bar communication skills, both written and oral, to interface in a collaborative team environment
  • Well-organized individual that pays close attention to detail
  • Able to effectively prioritize in a fast-paced and fast-changing environment
  • Bonus if you have experience integrating with large retail e-commerce sites

About Us:

Bold Metrics, established in 2017, is a SaaS solution for retailers and brands to reduce returns, improve sustainability and supercharge their supply chain from the ground up. Using a comprehensive set of machine learning and AI technologies to accurately capture customer body measurements, we help apparel brands unlock the power of body data to meet the demands of today's increasingly personalized world.

Learn more about us at boldmetrics.com

Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.

Summary

Administers all forms of respiratory care, both critical and general therapy, and directs and manages the respiratory and pulmonary care for a designated group of patients. Provides respiratory assessment, support, treatment, and diagnostic tests as part of the healthcare team.

Job Duties
  • Conducts evaluation, management and care of patients with deficiencies and abnormalities of the cardiopulmonary system.
  • Performs inventory of respiratory equipment and maintains adequate stock of equipment.
  • Provides respiratory therapy to patients as ordered by physicians according to established standards and practices.
  • Trains other staff including physicians and students in issues relevant to respiratory therapy.
  • Performs mechanical ventilator management, Bi-pap, and respiratory monitoring.
  • Performs emergency cardiopulmonary resuscitation and maintains adequate airways, measures ventilator volumes, pressures, and flows of patients requiring critical care.
  • Performs arterial blood gas studies as well as pulse oximetry, interpretation, and analysis.
  • Educates patients in collaboration in various clinical situations such as sleep apnea and CPAP machines, proper fitting of mask and headgear, and setting of pressures in concordance to sleep studio requirements.
  • Sets-up diagnostic nocturnal sleep screens.
  • Sets up, checks equipment, and administers respiratory medication for aerosol treatment as ordered by the physicians/or by patient-driven protocols, charts treatment, response, and progress.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care.
  • Less than 1 year.
  • Ability to provide respiratory therapy methodologies and techniques.
  • Ability to operate and trouble-shoot diagnostic equipment.
  • RRT - Registered Respiratory Therapist NBRC - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year.
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days.
  • PALS - Pediatric Advanced Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • NRP - Neonatal Resuscitation Program - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • RCP - Respiratory Care Practitioner - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care.
Physical Demands

Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

description:
Join to apply for the Analyst, Infrastructure 16468 role at GIC

Join to apply for the Analyst, Infrastructure 16468 role at GIC

GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.
The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.
Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.
We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What Impact Can You Make In This Role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.
What You Will Do As An Analyst

  • Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
  • Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
  • Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
  • Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
  • Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
  • The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.

What makes you a successful candidate?
  • Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
  • Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
  • Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
  • You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
  • Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.

Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.
We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.
Learn More
Learn more about our Infrastructure Department here: PRIME Values
GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

ATRIBUIÇÕES PRINCIPAIS

  1.   2. Realizar procedimentos invasivos preferencialmente em dupla através das diretrizes do modelo assistencial para garantir as melhores práticas institucionais;
  3. Receber o plantão e proceder a assistência direta aos pacientes, observando, acompanhando, reconhecendo sinais/sintomas e registrando as ações e, ao término do plantão informar e esclarecer a assistência prestada aos pacientes através da passagem de plantão em instrumento estruturado institucional;
  4. Realizar e planejar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) estabelecendo níveis de responsabilidade na execução das ações planejadas entre equipe de enfermagem, avaliando os resultados e registrando-os durante a internação, através das necessidades de cada paciente.
  5. Coordenar processos que garantam uma assistência segura e de qualidade a todos os pacientes sob sua responsabilidade nas diferentes situações críticas, através das diretrizes institucionais, a fim de garantir uma assistência segura;
  6. Aprazar e conferir os itens de prescrição médica para continuidade da assistência segura;
  7. Reconhecer e priorizar de acordo com a complexidade assistencial as situações de emergência mediante a necessidade de cada paciente, direcionando a assistência a ser prestada, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as normas, regulamentos e legislações pertinentes às áreas de atuação, contribuir para a elaboração e implementação de manuais técnicos operacionais para a equipe de enfermagem nos diversos setores de atuação e de manuais educativos aos clientes e familiares;
  8. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares;
  9. Apoiar demais setores, conforme direcionamento de liderança, viabilizando o atendimento de todos os pacientes internados no HSC;
  10. Participação ativa em visita multidisciplinar buscando o alinhamento das necessidades assistenciais dos pacientes e familiares sob sua responsabilidade;
  11. Garantir a comunicação ativa junto a equipe multidisciplinar visando facilitar o planejamento e execução das ações pertinentes as boas práticas e contribuir com o desenvolvimento do colaborador, através de educação em atividades baseadas em normas, protocolos e procedimentos institucionais, visando a atualização e aperfeiçoamento da equipe de enfermagem;
  12. Realizar o acompanhamento e treinamento de colaboradores recém-admitidos, com exercício de mesma função assistencial;
  13. Garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais;
  14. Exercer as atividades baseado nos protocolos institucionais na busca da prevenção e controle sistemático de danos a pacientes durante a assistência de saúde através do cumprimento das metas de segurança do paciente;
  15. Participar dos treinamentos e eventos institucionais pertinentes ao cargo;
  16. Multiplicar informações relacionadas a boas práticas assistenciais junto a equipe multidisciplinar de área de atuação, promovendo e difundindo medidas de prevenção de riscos e agravos por meio da educação paciente e familiares, objetivando melhorar a qualidade de vida do paciente;
  17. Realizar notificações de não conformidades e eventos identificados visando manter a qualidade e segurança da assistência prestada;
  18. Executar as práticas de segurança através do cumprimento das normativas da NR-32, medicina ocupacional, SCIH e SEST.

Sobre a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC)

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a ACSC é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

title: Trainmaster (CVRR)
description:
Supervises and coordinates activities of train crew engaged in switching railroad cars within yard of railroad, industrial plant, or similar location to facilitate loading or unloading of cars or making up and breaking up of trains; and/or switches railroad cars within yard of railroad, industrial plant, or similar location to load and unload cars or to make up or break up trains in a safe and efficient manner, by performing the following duties.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities :

  • Supervises and coordinates the activities of train crews.
  • Receives oral or written instructions from Manager or Customer indicating which cars are to be switched.
  • Notifies train crew of switching orders and, whereby, which cars are to be moved to specified locations of yard, using radio, telephone, verbal, or hand signals.
  • Manage cars online through various RMI reports.
  • Must ensure daily train lists are accurate as generated by the customer service department, and accurate as completed by the train crews within his/her territory.
  • Must ensure all reporting is done accurately and timely, including daily crew work sheets and weekly operational reporting.
  • Approve all man hours under his/her area of responsibility and forward these hours to the necessary personnel or department on a timely basis.
  • Initiate and provide an accurate, complete, and timely investigation of all accidents and incidents, including causes, remedial action, and recommended solutions.
  • Understand the quantitative factors contributing to the major costs on the railroad and understand the extent of their effect toward financial performances.
  • Adjust locomotive consist requirements based on HP and trailing tons daily, with a goal to minimize locomotive fuel and maximize locomotive utilization.
  • Understand all outstanding track conditions within his/her territory, including slow orders, and their effect on productivity/efficiency.
  • Demonstrate predictable, reliable, and timely attendance.
  • Knowledge of and skills in applying basic federal railroad regulations, guidelines, and rules.
  • Ability to read and comprehend written safety rules, procedure and safety manuals, government regulations, operating and maintenance instructions, memos, and other work-related information.
  • Ability to apply commonsense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, diagrammatic, or schedule form; and/or to apply principles of logic to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions; and/or to apply principles of rational systems to solve practical problems.
  • Ability to effectively communicate instructions, directions, processes, procedures, safety rules and regulations to co-workers, supervisors, and others in written, oral, diagrammatic and schedule form.
  • Ability to train switch crews and other yard personnel to perform job-related duties; and to provide training related to federal and company regulations, rules, safety guidelines and preventive maintenance.
  • Ability to make independent judgments using sound reasoning skills and knowledge base.
  • Ability to think and act quickly in responding to emergency and non-emergency situations.
  • Ability to talk to and effectively communicate with co-workers, yard personnel, switching crew, engineers, railroad officials and others in a clear, concise, courteous, efficient, and professional manner.
  • Promote and facilitate company safety initiatives and instill a culture of safety
  • Manages the operational testing program by observing, documenting, and evaluating safe work practices and rules compliance
  • Ability to pass training and required testing.
  • Performs other duties as requested or required

Machines, Tools, Special Equipment, Personal Protective Equipment Used:

  • PPE; hard hat, vest, safety glasses, FR clothing, gloves, steel toed boots

Education and Experience:

  • High school education or general education development (GED), and minimum of 6 months job-related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to pass training and required testing.

Certificates and Licenses:

  • Must hold, and continue to hold, a current locomotive engineers and conductor’s certification.

Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The team member is regularly exposed to outside weather conditions and elements, noise, and fumes from gas, oil, and grease.

Note: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by team members assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

Arquiteto de Dados - Curitiba/PR ou São Paulo/SP

Join to apply for the Arquiteto de Dados - Curitiba/PR ou São Paulo/SP role at MadeiraMadeira

Na MadeiraMadeira, temos uma missão clara: incentivar uma cultura orientada a dados, otimizando a descentralização e autonomia de análises, suportando melhores decisões que permitam prover a melhor experiência aos nossos clientes.

A área de dados oferece uma série de oportunidades desafiadoras e emocionantes, especialmente no que diz respeito à arquitetura de dados. Como parte de uma equipe dedicada, você estará envolvido em projetos que visam estruturar, integrar e governar dados de maneira eficiente e inovadora, com o objetivo de impactar diretamente o sucesso da empresa.

A crescente demanda por dados e informações exige arquiteturas escaláveis e flexíveis, e sua missão será criar soluções que garantam a capacidade de lidar com grandes volumes de dados de forma ágil e eficaz. Trabalhar com fontes de dados diversificadas, como sistemas internos, bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, além de APIs e outras plataformas, será uma oportunidade de aplicar e expandir suas habilidades na integração de dados.

A otimização da performance também será uma das suas missões. Ao integrar ferramentas analíticas avançadas, como business intelligence e machine learning, você contribuirá para o design de fluxos de dados que suportem análises em tempo real ou em batches de forma eficiente, sem sobrecarregar o sistema. Aqui, você terá a chance de aplicar suas habilidades em engenharia de dados para criar soluções robustas e de alta performance.

A evolução constante das necessidades do negócio será um estímulo para sua criatividade e inovação. Sua capacidade de adaptar e atualizar a arquitetura de dados para atender às novas demandas, tecnologias e fontes de dados será essencial, garantindo que a empresa esteja sempre à frente das tendências e preparada para o futuro.

Em resumo, a missão na área de dados será desafiadora, mas cheia de oportunidades de crescimento e impacto. Você terá a chance de moldar a arquitetura de dados de forma estratégica, promovendo eficiência, inovação e segurança, e tornando-se uma peça chave para o sucesso da organização. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, em constante evolução e com um grande potencial de impacto, essa é a oportunidade ideal para alavancar sua carreira na área de dados.

Na MadeiraMadeira acreditamos que a base para uma operação eficiente, escalável e orientada a dados é uma arquitetura sólida e moderna. O Arquiteto de Dados será responsável por desenhar, implementar e evoluir uma arquitetura de dados que suporte os desafios de um varejo digital dinâmico e em constante crescimento.

Seu papel será garantir que os dados estejam disponíveis, confiáveis e acessíveis para as áreas de negócio, produto e operações. Você liderará a transformação da infraestrutura de dados, promovendo governança robusta, integração ágil de dados e escalabilidade. O objetivo final é habilitar decisões mais rápidas e assertivas, reduzir perdas operacionais e impulsionar métricas críticas, como aumento do GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) e redução de custos logísticos.

O Que Estamos Procurando

Buscamos um profissional apaixonado por resolver problemas complexos de dados, com experiência em ambientes de alta escala e em iniciativas que conectem tecnologia e estratégia de negócios.

Venha transformar o futuro do e-commerce de casa com a gente.

  • Principais Responsabilidades
    • Planejamento e Implementação da Arquitetura de Dados :
      • Liderar a adoção da arquitetura de dados baseada no modelo Medalhão, habilitando domínios de dados conforme os princípios do Data Mesh.
      • Definir padrões e frameworks para a ingestão, processamento, armazenamento e consumo de dados, garantindo escalabilidade e eficiência.
    • Governança e Qualidade de Dados :
      • Implementar políticas e ferramentas de governança para garantir consistência, segurança e qualidade dos dados.
      • Estabelecer um modelo de single source of truth, minimizando redundâncias e inconsistências.
    • Colaboração Estratégica :
      • Trabalhar em parceria com times de engenharia, ciência de dados, produto e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções arquiteturais.
      • Garantir que a arquitetura de dados apoie iniciativas estratégicas, como personalização, otimização logística e redução de custos operacionais.
    • Inovação e Otimização Contínua :
      • Monitorar tendências e inovações em arquitetura de dados, avaliando tecnologias como data lakes, data warehouses e ferramentas de observabilidade.
      • Otimizar pipelines e fluxos de dados para melhorar desempenho e custo-benefício.
    • Mentoria e Liderança Técnica :
      • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico do time, promovendo boas práticas e cultura de dados.
      • Servir como referência técnica em projetos críticos relacionados à arquitetura de dados.
Principais Ferramentas, Tecnologias e Padrões

O Arquiteto de Dados deve dominar uma ampla gama de ferramentas e tecnologias modernas para projetar e implementar soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio. Isso inclui ferramentas de processamento e orquestração de dados para garantir fluxos de dados automatizados e resilientes. Tecnologias de armazenamento e análise são essenciais para a construção de data lakes e warehouses performáticos. Além disso, o uso de frameworks distribuídos é indispensável para o processamento de grandes volumes de dados em tempo real ou batch.

Em relação aos padrões de mercado, o arquiteto deve ter profundo conhecimento de arquiteturas como Data Lakehouse , Data Mesh , e Lambda/Kappa Architectures , que atendem às necessidades de escalabilidade, descentralização e processamento em tempo real. Domínio em governança e qualidade de dados e confiabilidade dos dados. Além disso, é esperado conhecimento em linguagens de programação bem como proficiência em SQL para modelagem e consulta de dados. Por fim, o entendimento de frameworks de segurança e compliance, como ISO 27001 , LGPD , e GDPR , é fundamental para mitigar riscos e garantir a conformidade regulatória.

Indicadores de Sucesso
  • Redução de inconsistências em dados críticos para abaixo de 5%.
  • Aumento da disponibilidade da plataforma de dados para 99,9%.
  • Implementação de domínios de dados com uso efetivo em múltiplas áreas de negócio.
  • Redução de custos operacionais relacionados à gestão e integração de dados em 20%.
  • Habilitação de insights que impulsionem GMV e melhorem KPIs de eficiência logística.
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de dados de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks e metodologias de maturidade de dados, como o Dell Maturity Model.
  • Inglês avançado para interação com stakeholders globais e documentação técnica.
Diferenciais

  • Experiência em varejo digital ou e-commerce de grande escala.
  • Contribuições em comunidades ou projetos open-source relacionados a arquitetura de dados.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

  • Assessoria na montagem de operações estruturadas;
  • Contato ativo com os maiores clientes de renda variável da XP para acompanhamento de posição e atualização de cenário de mercado;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes e assessores no universo de renda variável.

O que buscamos

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com colegas de trabalho: Interação com futuros pares para avaliar a sinergia e o trabalho em equipe.

Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

title: HR Business Partner, People Experience and Technology (PXT) - HR
description:
HR Business Partner, People Experience and Technology (PXT) - HR

At Amazon, we are committed to being the safest place to work in the world, the best employer, and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic people who are passionate about making each day better for all employees — and you will play a crucial role in this journey! Our People eXperience & Technology (PXT - Human Resources) professionals care deeply about the employee experience and support employees and leaders in focusing on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.

Key job responsibilities
In this position, you will be responsible for the entire PXT (People eXperience and Technology - Human Resources) agenda in an Amazon logistics warehouse located in São João de Meriti - RJ. The generalist role in HR will involve managing the mobilization/demobilization of workforce in different hiring formats, internal communication and employee engagement, leadership development at supervisor to manager levels, general coordination of labor and employee relations issues, consolidation and reporting of metrics (absenteeism, attrition, operational vacancy fill rates), indirect coordination of chartered transportation and restaurant, continuous improvement plans for employee experience, Diversity and Inclusion programs, among others.

A day in the life
As an HRBP of a "Fulfillment Center - FC", no two days are alike, but a typical day will likely include the following responsibilities:

  1. Work with a team of HR Assistants to create the best experience for employees.
  2. Lead the reporting and analysis of Human Resources metrics and goals ("attendance", "attrition", "fill-rate", delving into root cause analyses and improvement plans).
  3. Participate in "Daily Dive Deep – DDD" meetings along with the Operations team and other support areas.
  4. Co-lead workforce planning meetings, execution of mobilization and demobilization of personnel contingent.
  5. Conduct "Gemba" and monitor operational processes, as well as the work environment and people's needs, on the "shop-floor".
  6. Monitor the environment from a labor and employee relations perspective, identifying trends and risks.
  7. Participate in Brazil PXT Operations team meetings, reporting metrics and indicators of your operation.
  8. Lead PXT and multidisciplinary projects that go beyond your work unit.
  9. Promote and model an inclusive environment for all employees through specific programs, local initiatives, and affinity groups.
  10. Serve as the first point of escalation for employee concerns.
  11. Support employee inquiries and situations with discretion and experience, along with routine standard work on employee onboarding, performance management, engagement processes, and benefits services.
  12. Train, develop, and support leadership through decision-making.
  13. Collaborate with various levels of the organization, from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  14. Influence and guide partners to prioritize employee experience and customer obsession.

About the team
We could be a great match if you:
  • Are excited to work in a fast-paced and team-oriented environment.
  • Are enthusiastic about working in a production environment (logistics warehouse) engaging our teams, training our leaders, and creating the best place in the world to work.
  • Are excited about generalist positions where each day you will deal with various Human Resources topics.
  • Are enthusiastic about flexing your routine when necessary, making room to occasionally work night shifts or weekends, in an operation that runs 24/7 every day of the year.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Completed Bachelors Degree
Experience in generalist Human Resources subsystems.
Experience in supporting massive and operational customer groups (factories, warehouses, call centers, etc).
Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (reads and writes easily and fluently, understands ~85% when listening and can provide quick and objective answers).
Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel at an intermediate level (VLOOKUP and pivot tables); BI tools will be a differential.
Must be willing to work 100% on-site at the FC in São João de Meriti-RJ, with flexibility in hours and days, especially during peak periods or promotions (Prime Day, Black Friday).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience in HR for factory/manufacturing, transportation company, distribution center, or logistics.
Masters Degree

description:
XP Future 2025 | Transição de Carreira - Espírito Santo

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP FUTURE , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Estaremos presencialmente no Espírito Santo para nosso processo seletivo e expandir ainda mais nosso time!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar em nosso Programa de Formação XP Future:

  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros).
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais, mas não eliminatórios:

  • Certificação CPA-20.

Principais desafios da cadeira:

  • Prospecção de novos negócios - poder de originação/novos clientes;
  • Organização para trabalhar diversas frentes em curto período de tempo;
  • Forte poder de persuasão;
  • Empatia e visão de longo prazo;
  • Gestão de carteiras e grandes contas - Pessoa Física e Pessoa Jurídica.

Obs: Contratação CLT

Sobre as etapas do processo seletivo - XP Future 2025 - Espírito Santo

  • Realização da etapa de testes - Fit cultural e PI (Obrigatórios)
  • Bate papo com o time de Expansão;
  • Processo seletivo presencial na cidade;
  • As pessoas candidatas aprovadas em processo seletivo serão admitidas no regime CLT e vão atuar na área do B2C;
  • Após início na XP Inc., os assessores contarão com capacitação teórica, cursos preparatórios e treinamentos para as certificações - CPA-20.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP Vitória ! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

“Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque.”

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

Conheça mais sobre a função de Especialista de Proteção de Dados Sênior :

Você irá atuar como Especialista de Proteção de Dados Sênior, com a missão de assegurar que informações confidenciais sejam mapeadas, classificadas, protegidas e governadas de acordo com as regulamentações vigentes, políticas e normas internas e melhores práticas, garantindo a segurança e privacidade e minimizando riscos de violações ou sanções.

Juntos com você, em infinitas possibilidades.

#VemPraCima #VemPraCielo

  • Apoiar a equipe de conscientização no desenvolvimento de programas internos de treinamento focado nas melhores práticas de privacidade e proteção de dados.
  • Ser referência técnica da área em assuntos sobre privacidade e proteção de dados, provendo liderança técnica com o time e auxiliando profissionais mais juniores.

  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de governança de dados.
  • Perfil resolutivo, proativo e excelente capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

title: Junior In-Play Trader
description:
Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 19 markets.We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation,or age.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let's start with the role

This role is an opportunity to learn how the odds evolve during a game. The In-play Trading team is responsible for covering all live in-play events and plays a crucial role in shaping our customer experience.

An In-play trader manages events from a wide range of sports, including football, basketball, tennis but also general sports such as volleyball, ice-hockey, beach volleyball etc. They even offer special markets in many of them, surpassing those by other operators. This position demands concentration and observation, combined with a mathematical background, in order to ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience for our users.

The role requires a flexible working schedule to cover the busy sporting calendar (weekends, evenings etc.)

As an In Play Trader you will:

  • Monitor real - time sports events and perform live trading;
  • Supervise and adjust data with the aim of providing precise and competitive live odds;
  • Provide accurate and rapid resulting for any event of a variety of sports;
  • Use both external providers and in-house odds to optimize/customize our offerings and performance;
  • Evaluate events according to their potential demand, to offer the widest and the most competitive offer market wise;.
  • Continuously monitor bet placements, assess live events risks and take appropriate measures to manage and mitigate risks;
  • Ensure that customers have access to the most up-to-date and competitive odds, enhancing the overall betting experience;
  • Maintain effective communication within the trading team and with external stakeholders to ensure a unified and coordinated approach.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g statistics, mathematics,finance)
  • Strong interest in sports with a good understanding of various sports and betting markets;
  • Proven analytical and mathematical skills;
  • Betting/sportsbook playing experience/activity;
  • Be able to make quick, well-informed decisions and work within tight deadlines;
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills;
  • Multitasking abilities and PC literacy;
  • Fluency in English;
  • Willingness to work flexible hours in line with the business and sports calendar requirements.

  • Reviews/ verifies the control design, schematics and drawings delivered by the Technical Designer.

  • Builds mock-ups to test inter-operability and/or features of the sub-system.
  • Provides technical expertise in sales presentations, product demonstrations, installation and maintenance.
  • Validates delivered solution ensuring all building blocks are functioning according to specifications and ensuring Lifecycle services capabilities.
  • Preparation of system testing and turnover documentation including scoped documents, test records, test procedures and other similar required documents.

  • Prepare system turnover packages in accordance with project procedures by assembling and reviewing all system test documentation (all disciplines) for adequacy and completeness.
  • Monitor and control system performance and be accountable for performance of the system against the budget.

  • Enhances design with key points included by proposal manager in the consolidated proposal.
  • Develops, trains and deploys user instruction/ manuals to customer organization during handover.
  • Works with all Stakeholders in the creation of quotes for architectures selected, system additions and upgrades.
  • Drives for high levels of customer satisfaction by ensuring timely and correct execution of service obligations in accordance with the contracts (warranty and Service) and/or solving of complaints, inquiries and requests about technical products.
  • Analyses and solves application failures, complaints (on or offsite), supports upgrades, drives root cause analysis and preventive action. Keeps customers proactively informed.
  • Drives feedback loops towards Systems & Service Centers / Divisions.
  • Fulfills documentations for service-related issues and resolutions and / or keeps complaint database up to date.
  • Proposes additional services as required through maintaining intimate customer relationship.
  • Provides special / custom training to customers upon request.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree completed in Electrical, Electronic, Automation, or Mechatronic Engineering.

  • Solid knowledge in specification and documentation of design patterns within own engineering domain.

  • Familiar with industry-standard work processes for system testing and commissioning.

  • Proven experience in managing suppliers and subcontractors effectively.

  • Fluent in Spanish (mandatory); English proficiency is highly desirable.

  • Willing and available to travel up to 50%.

*This is an on-site position.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data and Analytics
description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.

You will have the opportunity to make a big impact on our business performance as you support the data strategy and lead the development of custom models/algorithms. Working in close partnership with the business leadership team, you will manage the vision and agenda for business analytics in your area of responsibility.

How you will contribute

  1. Drive the vision and delivery of data-driven products for Mondelez finance following established product management practices.

  2. Prioritize development items according to deadlines, business context, and technical needs.

  3. Advocate for and manage funding, including budgeting, headcount needs, and other costs.

  4. Partner with engineering teams to move finance data products to AI-readiness.

  5. Identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, resilience, and innovation in Mondelez’s data landscape.

  6. Bridge conversations between finance business stakeholders and development teams, leveraging knowledge of both Mondelez business domains and technical expertise.

  7. Think strategically, connecting stakeholder use cases to technology solutions and considering the end-to-end experience.

  8. Deeply understand stakeholder needs, product analytics, and industry innovation to drive the product vision and strategy, maximizing business and customer impact.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • HIGHLY ORGANIZED and able to manage competing priorities across stakeholders.

  • LEADERSHIP SKILLS including a natural ability to make things happen while proactively managing ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies in an organized and structured way.

  • DESIGN and data visualization experience with Tableau or Power BI.

  • BUSINESS ACUMEN and strong working knowledge of corporate finance.

  • GROWTH/DIGITAL MINDSET and the ability to identify and execute opportunities leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

  • CLOUD EXPERIENCE with data solutions in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in data and analytics, including data warehousing, SQL, machine learning, and familiarity with modern AI techniques.

  • EXPERIENCE with financial systems such as SAP, SAC, and Hyperion is a plus.

  • INTEGRITY and sound judgment in all decisions and interactions, aligned with our values, policies, and external regulations.

More about this role

We recognize our role as transformation agents to generate positive change, prioritizing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We aim to break stereotypes and barriers to ensure societal representation within our company. Our Diversity Committee operates on four fronts: People with disabilities (PCD), Ethnic-Racial, Women, and LGBTQIAP+, and we are part of MOVER – Movimento pela Equidade Racial.

What you need to know about this position:

As Senior Product Manager for Financial Data & Analytics, you will oversee the development and execution of our financial data products roadmap. Using a mix of technical knowledge and business acumen, you will help Mondelez’s Finance organization build data and analytics products aimed at an AI-ready future. Your products will serve decision-makers at the highest levels, improving measurement and insight through Mondelez’s data. As demand for data and insights grows within Mondelez, your contribution will foster the delivery of timely, relevant, and accurate insights to teams that need them.

What extra ingredients you will bring:

Preferred Experience:

  • Management consulting experience is a plus.
  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or corporate finance departments.
  • Experience with GenAI applications and LLMs.

Travel requirements:

  • Limited travel up to 20% of the time.

Mondelez International values the well-being of our people and offers flexible work arrangements, including hybrid models with remote work options on certain days.

No relocation support is available.

Business Unit Summary

Mondelez Brasil is the company's fourth-largest operation worldwide, with approximately 7,500 employees. We produce, sell, and distribute beloved brands such as Oreo, Lacta, Trident, and many more, in Brazil. Our products are available in over 700,000 points of sale and in more than 92% of Brazilian homes. Our factories are located in Vitória de Santo Antão and Curitiba, and we operate one of the company's 11 global technology centers, dedicated to R&D.

Mondelez International is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

Job Type: Regular, Analytics & Modelling, Data Science

Dentro desta função, suas funções durante os primeiros meses serão focadas no processo de treinamento e acompanhamento da área de vendas de campo. Com o apoio da equipe de vendas da Hilti, você se dedicará a:

  1. Entender como funciona a execução disciplinada e o desenvolvimento de negócios na Hilti
  2. Suporte na identificação e proposição de novas oportunidades de negócios

Nossos funcionários compartilham um estilo muito próprio de ser. São determinados e dedicados, dando sempre o melhor si para exceder as expectativas dos nossos clientes, e em contrapartida, usufruem de carreiras incrivelmente dinâmicas e diversificadas. 93% dos nossos colaboradores dizem estar orgulhosos em trabalhar para a Hilti, graças à qualidade dos nossos produtos e a forma como cuidamos dos nossos colaboradores.

description:
We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!

At Azion you will have the opportunity to develop and be connected to cutting-edge technology, immersed in a culture centered on innovation and a high-performance team, unlocking new possibilities and working with the future of technology.

About The Position

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team at our São Paulo/SP office. As part of the Engineering department, the selected candidate will be responsible for developing highly concurrent systems in Rust, optimizing performance, distributed caching, and connection management to handle thousands of requests per second with low latency.

  • Concurrent and Asynchronous Programming: Implement highly concurrent systems in Rust, leveraging async/await and efficient thread management to handle thousands of requests per second;
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize system resource usage, including memory management and throughput maximization, ensuring low latency even under high load;
  • Distributed Caching Management: Develop and maintain efficient caching systems across a globally distributed network, addressing challenges such as consistency and cache invalidation;
  • Upstream Connection Management: Maintain stable and efficient connections with upstream services, including load balancing, automatic reconnections, and backpressure management in large-scale network communication.

Requirements

  • Experience in systems development with Rust and low-level programming;
  • Understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS;
  • Familiarity with secure development practices;
  • Familiarity with Linux and operating systems;
  • Knowledge of version control (Git);
  • Background in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Knowledge of CI/CD and automation pipelines;

Differentials

  • Experience with Edge/CDN;
  • Experience with TCP sockets and Unix sockets;
  • Familiarity with Internet protocol RFCs;
  • Knowledge of HTTP proxy cache daemons such as Nginx, Caddy, and Envoy;

We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team but also boosts creativity and innovation.

After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.

Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!

title: [Talent Pool] Investor XP | Rio de Janeiro
description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região Sudeste. Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

Diferenciais:

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Presencial no Rio de Janeiro e proximidades.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.

Your Career

Palo Alto Networks is scaling its world-class strategy organization and looking for Team Manager in the area of security services. Though our security services are successful both in the market as well as at preventing attackers, the landscape is continually changing and in need of innovation leadership. The Palo Alto Networks Strategy function is a focused team that works on our most mission-critical business challenges to drive and support our industry-leading growth.

As a Manager, of the renewals Team, your efforts will directly impact the overall strategy and success of a world-leading cybersecurity business. You will collaborate on complex business and technology problems that are top-of-mind for our executives, particularly as those relate to key partnerships having strategic value to the business. You will lead initiatives with stakeholders to formulate mutually beneficial and measurable outcomes for technical and business objectives with strategic partners. You possess a unique blend of business insight, business strategy experience, big-picture thinking, influencing skills and ability to collaborate with a large number of constituents within Palo Alto Networks.

Your Impact

  • Manage the overall day to day renewal operations of assigned direct reportsand districts / regions in the LATAM regions
  • Motivate your direct reports to drive pipeline development and revenues through renewal sales efforts leveraging the partner network
  • Ability to accurately forecast to leadership teams and drive a committed number on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis to SR. Manager and VP
  • Coaching and development of subordinates, bi-weekly 121's
  • Supervise and assist direct reports on large deals through to completion
  • Evaluate, and document, yourdirect reports based on Key Metrics and goals set by Leadership
  • Monitor the outbound efforts of assigned you renewals reps by tracking and reporting weekly activities
  • Collaborate with Sales Leaders to identify strategies to achieve sales goals and uncover new, high value opportunities alongside renewals
  • Provide accurate, ongoing reporting through the continuous update and maintenance of necessary reports in Salesforce.com and other tools and applications
  • Provide support for renewal escalations and your assigned districts

Your Experience

  • At least 3+years experience in Managing diverse enterprise renewals /sales teams
  • At least 3+ years experience in leading 8-15 people, in the office and remote work environments
  • At least 3+ years Experience in hiring, developing and retaining talent
  • Proven Experience with channel /partner sales models renewals/ upsells
  • Proven to consistently achieve renewal/ sales team goals through your leadership
  • Proven ability to learn new technology quickly, as well as adapt to changing needs
  • Excellent communication skills -the ability to build cross-functional relationships
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills -the ability to work on many projects concurrently
  • Excellent Microsoft Excel, Google Suite and Salesforce.com skills

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

About the role

The role of the IT system engineer can be both challenging and rewarding. This role requires strong technical expertise, along with business acumen, interpersonal skills, and a passion for continuous improvement. As a Systems Engineer, you will be a member of a global IT operations team. Your main responsibilities include designing, implementing, and maintaining IT infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the stability, security, and scalability of our systems, as well as participate in on-call team rotations. Your expertise in infrastructure as code, systems infrastructure, cloud technologies, and network infrastructure will be crucial in driving our success.

This is a FULL Remote position so good home internet is required, and hours will be, Monday - Friday between 8:00AM and 5:00 PM in the employee’s time zone.

Key Responsibilities:

•Infrastructure as Code: Develop and manage infrastructure through automation using Ansible, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.

•Systems Infrastructure: Implement and maintain virtualization, containerization (Docker), SAN, BDR, and patch/vulnerability management solutions for Windows and Linux

•Cloud: Manage and optimize cloud services, including Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra, and Exchange Online.

•Network Infrastructure: Design and maintain network infrastructure, including routing, switching, firewall policy, VPNs (point-to-point and site-to-site), SD-WAN, load balancers, ACLs and NSGs

Qualifications:

•Effective communication in English (oral and written).

•3-5 years’ experience as a Systems Engineer or similar role.

It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

You will be part of an international team, leading the development of 1GLOBAL's entitlement server platform. We are looking for a developer to join the team, working collaboratively to design and implement new services, maintain existing components, and test our applications.
We run a multi-site platform, following strict security requirements, provide the service to customers around the world and manage millions of subscriber profiles. We embrace a highly collaborative and diverse environment, value teamwork, autonomy and hold ourselves accountable for our deliverables and customer success.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

  • Develop high-impact features and contribute to the architecture design, focusing on resilience, scalability, security, and fault tolerance;
  • Advocate for high code quality, readability, and extensive test coverage;
  • Promote best practices for a high-traffic web (or mobile) environment;
  • Work with Agile methodology;
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and promote these improvements through seamless integrations, documenting solutions and new workflows;
  • Mentor junior team members when necessary and contribute to meaningful code reviews.

  • Proficiency with REST APIs, both in implementing and consuming interfaces;
  • Familiarity with relational databases, CI/CD workflows, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes;
  • Familiarity with development tools and processes;
  • Understanding of cloud services and scalable infrastructure;
  • Excellent communication skills (fluent in English, both written and spoken), with an autonomous and motivated mindset.

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
